description: This file implements string-to-map and set data structures, including initialization, insertion, lookup, removal, and clearing functions for string maps and string sets, as well as auxiliary functions for reference counting and custom memory management.

methods.name: int cmp_strmap_entry(const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * entry1,const struct hashmap_entry * entry2,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: Comparison function for hashmap entries based on string keys.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * find_strmap_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieve a hashmap entry corresponding to a given string key.

methods.name: void strmap_init(struct strmap * map)
methods.description: Initialize a strmap structure to an empty state.

methods.name: void strmap_init_with_options(struct strmap * map,struct mem_pool * pool,int strdup_strings)
methods.description: Initialize a strmap with custom memory pool and strdup options.

methods.name: void strmap_free_entries_(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Internal function to free entries and optionally their values.

methods.name: void strmap_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Clear the entire strmap, optionally freeing values.

methods.name: void strmap_partial_clear(struct strmap * map,int free_values)
methods.description: Partially clear the strmap, preserving structure but freeing entries.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * create_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Create a new hashmap entry with optional string duplication and allocation.

methods.name: void * strmap_put(struct strmap * map,const char * str,void * data)
methods.description: Insert or update a value associated with a string key.

methods.name: struct:strmap_entry * strmap_get_entry(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieve a hashmap entry for a given string key.

methods.name: void * strmap_get(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Retrieve the value associated with a string key.

methods.name: int strmap_contains(struct strmap * map,const char * str)
methods.description: Check if a string key exists in the map.

methods.name: void strmap_remove(struct strmap * map,const char * str,int free_value)
methods.description: Remove an entry from the map by string key, optionally freeing the value.

methods.name: void strintmap_incr(struct strintmap * map,const char * str,intptr_t amt)
methods.description: Increment a numeric value associated with a string key.

methods.name: int strset_add(struct strset * set,const char * str)
methods.description: Add a string to the set; returns 1 if added, 0 if already present.

ctags.signature: (const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * entry1,const struct hashmap_entry * entry2,const void * keydata UNUSED)

ctags.pattern: /^void strintmap_incr(struct strintmap *map, const char *str, intptr_t amt)$/

ctags.pattern: /^void strmap_remove(struct strmap *map, const char *str, int free_value)$/
